# Golden output fixtures

Generated by Python `psort` (plaso v20260928) on `test_data/psort_test.plaso`.
Each module has a deduplicated fixture and an include-all (`-a`) fixture:

    psort      -o <module> -w <module>.<ext>      test_data/psort_test.plaso
    psort -a   -o <module> -w <module>_all.<ext>  test_data/psort_test.plaso

Covered modules (extension): `dynamic` (.csv), `l2tcsv` (.csv), `tln` (.txt),
`l2ttln` (.txt), `rawpy` (.txt), `json_line` (.txt), `json` (.txt). `null`
produces no output, so it has no fixture.

Time-zone / dynamic-time fixtures (deduplicated unless noted), used by
`TestTimeZoneAndDynamicTime`:

    dynamic_nyc.csv       -o dynamic --output_time_zone America/New_York
    dynamic_nyc_all.csv   -o dynamic --output_time_zone America/New_York -a
    dynamic_dt.csv        -o dynamic --dynamic_time
    dynamic_dt_nyc.csv    -o dynamic --dynamic_time --output_time_zone America/New_York
    l2tcsv_nyc.csv        -o l2tcsv  --output_time_zone America/New_York
    tln_dt.txt            -o tln     --dynamic_time

These are the differential-test oracle for the Go output modules. Regenerate /
verify against live Python with: `GOPLASO_PSORT_ORACLE=1 go test ./internal/pipeline/`
